}

  "sum": {{math 1 '+' 2}},
  "product": {{math request.query.qty '*' 25}},
  "modulo": {{math 10 '%' 3}},
  "encoded": "{{base64 'hello'}}",
  "decoded": "{{base64 'aGVsbG8=' decode=true}}",
  "urlEncoded": "{{urlEncode 'a b&c'}}",

  "capitalised": "{{capitalize request.query.name}}",
  "upper": "{{upper request.query.name}}",
  "size": {{size 'abcde'}},
  "orderNo": "{{regexExtract request.query.ref '[0-9]+'}}",
  "fallback": "{{regexExtract 'abc' '[0-9]+' default='none'}}"
}
